messages:
Anya: Heads-up — planning a canary for saved-query visibility changes in Console. Proposal: hide model-scoped saved queries from the route-level dropdown unless an `expose_to_route` flag is set. Need API shape + telemetry to decide rollout. thoughts?
Mike: sounds reasonable. what's the migration story for existing model-scoped queries?
Anya: migration plan idea: server-side mapping where existing model-only queries get `expose_to_route=false`. UI will offer an explicit opt-in to ‘expose’ per route. But we need telemetry to understand how many routes actually reference model-scoped filters.
Jess: can we get a quick metric: count of saved_queries with `scope=model` and occurrences in route_views over last 90d? Evan, can telemetry add that?
Evan: Yep. I'll add a sampled event `saved_query.viewed` with fields: `query_id`, `scope`, optional `route_id`, `model_id`, `user_tier`. Start sampling at 10% to limit cost. Can also emit `saved_query.bind` when a route pins a model-scoped query.
Sam: UX concern: if we hide them, folks might duplicate queries per-route and bump token usage. UI should surface a migration banner: "This query is model-scoped; create a route-level copy? Estimated cost delta:" with quick copy action.
Anya: Agreed. Also want backend API to support explicit migrate policies. Draft API:
```json
PATCH /api/saved_queries/{id}
{
  "expose_to_route": true,
  "migrate_policy": "copy_on_publish" // options: "copy_on_publish" | "link"
}
```
Jess: linking vs copying tradeoffs: linking keeps a single source of truth but makes per-route pin edits surprising. copy_on_publish feels safer: users get an independent route copy with backlink to origin.
Mike: backend work required for backlink records and a rollback path if we change policy mid-rollout. @eng-runtime FYI on potential data model changes.
Sam: cost preview needs token-burn telemetry per-saved-query. We already have token_burn per-route; can we approximate per-query by sampling executions with `query_id` tag?
Evan: I can surface `token_burn_estimate` for saved_queries by sampling 1% of executions and extrapolating by run frequency. Will add a 7d/30d view for the UI.
Anya: Decision checkpoint: 1) add telemetry events (saved_query.viewed, .bind, exec samples), 2) implement API with `migrate_policy` defaulting to `copy_on_publish`, 3) UI banner with estimated cost delta & copy button, 4) canary to 10% orgs next week, watch `saved_query.bind` and duplication rate.
Jess: :thumbsup: I'll draft the UI banner copy + mock, include the cost calc formula (avg tokens * avg daily runs * 30).
Mike: please add a DB migration plan to avoid locking large tables when we write backlinks. Also add an admin script to audit exposed vs hidden queries.
Evan: I'll emit the telemetry events to the "console-analytics" dataset and create a Grafana panel for the canary.
deploy-bot: canary job scheduled for 2024-04-10 09:00 UTC -> 10% orgs (prod).
Anya: Follow-ups: Jess to push mock by EOD, Evan to create panels, Mike to scope backend tickets, Sam to prototype the cost preview microcopy. We'll reconvene on Thursday for go/no-go.
